keySentence: Adversity does not create character — it reveals the character already there inside us.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Some people say that going through hard times is what makes a person strong and good. But Sara's story asks us to think about this very carefully before we agree. Sara was kind and imaginative and dignified long before any hardship came to find her. Her father had raised her to care about people and to value character over comfort. When poverty arrived it did not build these qualities — they were already fully formed inside her. What the hard times did was remove the wealth and comfort that had been surrounding her goodness. And so everyone around her finally saw clearly what had been inside Sara all along. Adversity does not create character — it reveals the character already there inside us.
